body:
Someone discovers the unconventional want has a constituency.

Backers fund the niche project, a crowd fills the room for the avoided topic, the strange preference finds its people; appetite and opportunity agree for once.

With Jupiter trine Lilith, the people who grow things put their weight behind a want that was never allowed to grow in the open.

Nobody resists, so the growth feels effortless and looks inevitable.

The growth may be real, but a want that grows this easily goes unexamined, and its original point can get lost inside its success.
